sect1.title: Read the wiki for repo codestyle!
sect1.para: For any questions, suggestions or help Contact Me

listitem.para: Avoid opening any new issues without having checked if your problem has already been reported. If there are no currently open issues that fit your problem's description, feel free to add it.
When writing an issue make sure to include a clear title and description as well as having filled out all the necessary information: System info, OS, OS-Version, ...
If possible add pictures of the issue.

sect1.title: Contributing
sect1.para: Before thinking of adding a contribution, think. Is it necessary? Will this actually be a useful/required feature? Is your implementation good? Provide clear and documented explanation as to what was changed.
